paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Model complexity analysis.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates a model complexity analysis by showing the scaled ratios of input complexity and embedding complexity as a function of vocabulary size. The x-axis is labeled "Vocab Size" and features a linear scale ranging from approximately 8000 to 40000, with numeric tick labels starting at 10000 and spaced at regular intervals of 5000. The plot includes identical primary (left) and secondary (right) y-axes, both labeled "Scaled Ratio," utilizing a linear scale with a value range from 0.0 to 1.0 and tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2. The "Input Complexity" is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, which exhibits a continuous, curved decline across the x-axis; it starts at a maximum y-value of 1.0 at an x-value of roughly 8000, decreases to approximately 0.37 at an x-value of 20000, and ends at a minimum y-value of 0.0 at an x-value of 40000. The "Embedding Complexity" is depicted by a solid cyan line with circular markers, displaying a steady, linear increase across the x-axis; it begins at a y-value of 0.0 at an x-value of roughly 8000, rises to approximately 0.37 at an x-value of 20000, and reaches a peak y-value of 1.0 at an x-value of 40000.
